svg.title: Four graphs: (a) an even function on [-4,4], symmetric about the y-axis, with (-4,2), (-3,0), (0,3), (3,0), (4,2); (b) an odd cubic-like curve through (-2,-1), the origin and (2,1); (c) an exponential-type curve that is neither even nor odd; (d) the odd function 1/x through (-1,-1) and (1,1).
